project_type: Google Apps Script PWA - Photo Timestamp/Timemark Web Application
build_system: None - GAS deploys directly. All client-side code embedded in HTML.
test_framework: Manual browser testing. No automated test framework (GAS constraint).
build_command: N/A - validate HTML/JS syntax with node
test_command: node --check on extracted JS sections, validate JSON files with node -e
verification_instructions: 1. Validate Code.gs syntax, 2. Validate index.html is well-formed, 3. Validate manifest.json is valid JSON, 4. Check that all required PWA elements are present, 5. Open index.html in browser to verify rendering
setup_instructions: No setup needed - all files are self-contained for GAS deployment
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to CDNs. GAS constraint: all frontend must be in single HTML file or use include pattern. Service worker and manifest served via GAS endpoints.
key_patterns: GAS pattern: doGet() returns HtmlService output. All heavy processing client-side using Canvas API. Libraries loaded via CDN. Data persisted in localStorage.
directory_structure: Flat structure required by GAS: Code.gs (backend), index.html (full app), manifest.json (PWA), sw.js (service worker)
